title: The Hartford To Acquire Equitable’s Employee Benefits Business
summary: Acquisition will accelerate The Hartford’s growth in its Priority Business segment focused on small and midsize employers Transaction includes Equitable’s Employee Benefits technology and approximately $500 million in premium The Hartford has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Equitable’s 1 Employee Benefits business, which focuses on providing small and midsize employers with flexible, non-medical benefits.
